name: Car dealership
description: Car dealership, 30 x 20 m: a 6 m tall showroom glazed on three sides under a white metal-panel fascia with a blank sign, three display cars inside (one on a turntable), a sales desk and a polished tile floor; behind it a single-storey office wing (corridor, three offices, toilet) and a ribbed-metal service workshop with two roller doors at the back, a roller door through to the showroom, a two-post vehicle lift, workbench and tool chests, a tyre rack, compressor and bay markings.
